relationships.subject: Baimai ointment
relationships.evidence_quote: The up-regulated levels of neuropeptides Cgrp, Sst, Sp and chemokines Ccl2 and Ccl3 along with the abnormal expression of p-P38, p-ERK and p-AKT in the DRG of DPN rats were alleviated by BM application.

relationships.subject: Baimai ointment
relationships.evidence_quote: Topical treatment of BM significantly improved the hypersensitivity of mechanical and thermal pain

key_findings: Topical Baimai ointment relieved pain hypersensitivity in DPN rats and normalized DRG Cgrp, Sst, Sp, Ccl2, Ccl3 and MAPK/AKT phosphorylation
